purpose: R109 duplicate method-name storage: exact image libubus C caller, candidate vs accepted R103 Rust daemon
statistical_unit: One ratio per physical paired window; 20 equal-size serial segments per side are aggregated. Ten independent router windows; segments are not independent replicates.
preflight: R109 1000-cycle paired smoke passed; run ten fresh 10000-cycle windows after final stock health; each window validates exact image shared-library hashes.
production: stock C throughout; only new disposable namespace processes are pinned; no governor/IRQ/production affinity changes
failure_rule: Stop on identity, correctness, collection, health, affinity or cleanup failure. Preserve failed window; never infer success from missing results.
design: Two independently started subject daemons pinned CPU 1; the exact-image C caller runs on CPU 0. The workload driver maps slot a to the accepted R103 Rust control and slot b to R109; each quartet alternates ABBA/BAAB request order. Ten independent router windows.
previous_data: C caller single-window smoke only; no pooling with Rust caller series.
comparison_family: One comparator x four metrics; exact rank intervals at the frozen family level.
slot_semantics: The runner uploads the logical slot b ELF as candidate and slot a ELF as before-candidate. The workload starts slot a on the first daemon and slot b on the second, so process roles are randomized by block. implementation=rs is only the upload path.
interpretation_rule: Candidate is supported for this exact C caller condition only when every relevant interval direction is assessed. No whole-system claim, memory claim, or pooling with Rust caller results.
previous_collection_note: The first 10000-cycle collection was protocol/cleanup successful but excluded: its analyzer exposed a plan/driver slot-role mismatch inherited from the old randomized plan. No samples from that window are pooled.
